name: pepu
description: Official Claude Code plugin marketplace for Pepe Unchained (PEPU) V2 builder tooling.

plugins.name: pepu-devkit
plugins.description: Builder infrastructure for Pepe Unchained (PEPU) V2 mainnet (chain 97741): a PEPU MCP server (32 tools, resources and prompts), 12 skills, 6 slash commands and a builder subagent. Everything is built on @pepu-chain/sdk: Google login with an embedded wallet, Privy session signers, sponsored transactions, and the combination (Google login, one on-chain session, no popups, no user gas). Scaffolds apps with create-pepu-app.
